name: todo
title: To-do
description: Your own to-dos for each workspace, kept in Mirador with no account or service to sign in to. The workspace's To-do tab lists what's open, the soonest due first, with what's overdue or due today standing out: add one with its time in plain words ("send the summary fri 14:00"), tick it off, edit it, or undo. Agents reach them too: ask any conversation to note something for later, and a morning routine can list every workspace's to-dos for the day ahead.
tagline: Your own to-dos for each workspace, in a tab beside the chat and within the agent's reach.
